properties.name: Turkey Fork
properties.fee_text: Entrance Fees: $5 per vehicle, per day. Over 6 people, add $1 per person. Covers day-use, picnic area, and boat launch. Use new fee machine. Campground Fees: $20 per campsite, per night at the full service camping area. $7 per campsite, per night at the tent camping area. Covers use of all other areas. Use new fee machine.

properties.name: Blue Lake Recreation Area
properties.fee_text: Day-use: Free Camping: $7 per night. Camping for Access or Senior pass holders: $3.50 per night

properties.name: Big Biloxi Recreation Area
properties.fee_text: Camping fee is $20 per night. Camping fee with Senior Pass is $13 per night. Pavilion reservation is $40.
properties.restrictions: Campgrounds are for recreational use only. All visitors to campers must pay overnight fees or leave by sundown. No loud noises that unreasonably disturb another are allowed. Loud noises include: radios, fireworks and generators. No firearms, air rifles or gas guns. No alcoholic beverages. Campground

properties.name: Clear Springs Recreation Area
properties.fee_text: Day Use Fees: Cars and trucks: $5 per vehicle Senior and Access Pass: $2.50 per vehicle Commercial vehicles, walk-ins and bicycles: $1 per person Senior and Access Pass: $.50 per person MS Adventure Pass: free Annual Pass: free Camping Fees: Campsite with hookups: $20 per night Senior and Access Pass: $13 per night Annual Pass: no camping benefits MS Adventure Pass: no camping benefits
